subject: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff: 

Pain points you shared
- Current search and QA assistant returns inconsistent results for product specs and regulatory docs (high false positives).
- Latency spikes on long documents frustrate internal users.
- Cost per query is becoming a blocker for scaling to 200+ daily users.

Goals for the 6-week POC
- Improve answer accuracy for product/regulatory queries (target: +20% exact-match on our eval set).
- Meet p50 latency < 200ms and p95 < 700ms for typical 1k token flows.
- Demonstrate 2x cost improvement vs your current hosted model by using caching and batching.

Proposed scope
- Ingest of select product + regulatory docs (approx 25k pages) and a 150-prompt evaluation set you agreed to share.
- Prototype an in-app assistant integration behind your SSO (no customer data export).
- Run automated evals each week and one human review at weeks 3 and 6.

Success metrics and evals
- Automated eval: exact-match and F1 on the 150-prompt set (weekly runs).
- Latency: p50 and p95 token generation, measured per route.
- Cost: per-response token cost and projected monthly cost at 200 users.

Owners & contacts
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (SE, POC owner), Rishi Malhotra (Infra lead), Aditya Rao (Solutions Eng).
- Acme: Samantha Price (Project lead), Product engineering contact TBD.

Timeline & next steps
1) This week: Acme sends sample prompt set and S3 access for doc ingestion.
2) Week 1: Redwood ingests docs, initial indexing, baseline eval.
3) Week 2-5: Iteration on prompts, caching config, latency tuning, weekly evals.
4) Week 6: Final report and handoff with recommended rollout plan.

Access/setup required from Acme
- Short-term S3 read role or a temporary export of the target document folder.
- A dev API key for internal testing (we will not persist customer keys in hosted logs).

Attachments: acme-redwood-poc-sow.pdf (SOW draft), acme-prompt-set-v1.csv (sample prompts), onboarding-access-instructions.txt

If this looks right, I can send a DocuSign SOW and schedule the kickoff for next Tuesday at 10am PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0124

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great, and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications: 

1) We can share a 150-prompt set plus an annotated subset for exact-match scoring by Thursday EOD.
2) For docs: we prefer to grant a read-only role on a temporary S3 prefix. We'll generate the role and share the ARN.
3) Security questionnaire: can you confirm who on your side will handle the SOC2/pen-test questions? We have a standard security checklist that procurement needs before we sign the SOW.

Also, Tuesday 10am PT works for the kickoff. Please go ahead and send the DocuSign and the calendar invite.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product
Acme Corp
samantha.price@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Thanks, Samantha — appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers below and a few additional logistics: 

Security questionnaire / evidence
- Primary contact for security questions: Neha Kapoor (security), and Rishi will handle infra specifics. I copied them on the questionnaire follow-up separately. We can provide SOC 2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and our standard data processing addendum.

DocuSign & calendar
- I just sent the DocuSign SOW (link: https://documentcloud.example/docusign/ACME-POC-SOW). Once signed we'll schedule the kickoff for Tue 10am PT.

Access steps (detailed)
1) Acme creates a read-only IAM role for prefix: arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod/poc-docs/* and shares the role ARN with aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com.
2) Aditya will create a short-lived access token and confirm ingestion plan.
3) We will run a scoped ingest (no exports beyond managed indices) and run the initial eval within 48h of access.

Prompt set and eval rubric
- Thanks for agreeing to the 150-prompt set. Please include the desired exact-match labels for the annotated subset. Our eval rubric will compute exact-match, F1, latency, and hallucination rate (manual review).

Slack/channel
- We'll set up a shared Slack channel (#acme-poc) for day-to-day coordination and attach a weekly status checklist in the channel.

Attachments: updated onboarding-access-instructions.txt (includes the IAM format), acme-prompt-set-v1.csv (placeholder)

I'll loop Neha and Rishi on the security questionnaire separately. Let me know when the role ARN is ready and I'll have Aditya pick it up.

Best,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Marissa — noted. We'll assign a dedicated infra slot on our Dedicated pool for the first two weeks to ensure we can hit the latency targets during tuning. Aditya, please confirm the ingestion window and any preferred instance types from Acme.

Infra checklist for Acme onboarding
- Temporary read-only IAM role (ARN)
- Confirm data sensitivity level (PII/regulated docs) so we can apply the right encryption/HSM controls
- Provide a contact for your SSO/IDP team if we need to configure SCIM or SAML for the test account

I'll also prepare a short runbook for the initial ingest and an internal alert to monitor p95 latency.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Infra
Redwood Inference
